# Urban Desire Female Archetypes / 都市欲望女性原型库

> A source-linked Chinese fiction research library: retrieve causal character mechanisms, compare candidates, and design original urban characters. Version v0.1.0 is a research preview; content is mainly Chinese.

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-discovery.py; do not edit by hand. -->

Facts, interpretations, and modern adaptations have separate layers. JSONL and the generated catalog aid retrieval; read the character card and its source record before treating any claim as a fact. Gold, Silver, PASS, scores, and confidence values are internal assessments, not independent certification. Some source locators and adaptations still need review; see the assessment below.

Original character age and an explicitly adult modern design are separate. Do not sexualize minors or age-unknown original characters, or copy a source work's distinctive plot. Original project expressions use CC BY 4.0; code uses MIT; third-party works, translations, and quotations keep their own rights.

The links below follow the maintained main branch. For repeatable use, replace main with v0.1.0 or a verified commit, and use the corresponding manifest. This file is an on-demand reading map following the llms.txt proposal; publishing it does not guarantee automatic discovery or search indexing.

## Start here

- [Reader entry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/README.md): Purpose, scope, and quick start in Chinese.

- [Repository rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/AGENTS.md): Source authority, age restrictions, and project boundaries.
- [AI integration and FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/docs/ai-integration.md): Browsing, local CLI, skill use, read-only MCP stdio, and version pinning.

## Machine data

- [Library manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/data/library-manifest.json): Version, counts, capabilities, entry points, license scopes, and canonical UTF-8 LF hashes.
- [Character catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/data/catalog.json): Stable card IDs, source-linked paths, main/release URLs, and interpretation summaries.
- [Reviewed JSONL summaries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/data/characters.jsonl): One machine retrieval record per card; subordinate to cards and sources.
- [Field contract and taxonomy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/data/archetypes.json): Archetype IDs, enums, required fields, and constraints; this is a project contract, not a JSON Schema document.
- [Master index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/indexes/master-index.md): A compact human-readable candidate list; resolve relative card links against this URL.

## Evidence and original design

- [Source rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/references/source-rules.md): Fact / Interpretation / Adaptation, editions, unknowns, and age evidence.
- [Hybridization rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/references/hybridization-rules.md): Combine mechanism slots while changing distinctive relations, events, and resolutions.
- [Quality gates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/references/quality-gate.md): Internal review criteria; do not present a pass as external validation.
- [Retrieval example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/examples/retrieval.md): Compare candidate mechanisms and read back source-linked evidence.
- [Open-source assessment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsfgmkg95d-source/urban-desire-female-archetypes/main/docs/open-source-assessment.md): Specific unresolved evidence and adaptation defects.
